listing.name: Theme Hospital / Theme Hospital Enhanced
listing.summary: Explore Theme Hospital / Theme Hospital Enhanced and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Use the appropriate runtime
steps.instruction: This reconstructs the DOS Theme Hospital executable. Its hospital.exe/hosp.exe outputs use DOS/4GW and DOSBox; they are not native Windows players to register directly. Before following the source build, establish the needed input and toolchain/component permissions: the guide names its accepted GOG offline installer/HOSPITAL.EXE, its first Nix shell downloads proprietary Watcom 10.5/10.6 CDs, and tools GPL does not grant rights to reconstructed, Miles, Smacker or Watcom code. An owned GOG copy alone does not settle every component. The conditional DOS build/run guide remains upstream; Portcove invokes no installer or toolchain. For a distinct managed native alternative, find CorsixTH in Discover.
